correctness.rationale: From the six source Caputo equations and 0<=S/N<=1, incidence g<=beta(I+theta A). The nonnegative infected linear Volterra majorant uses D=diag(sigma+d,kappa+r_I+d,r_A+d) and C coupling E to I/A. Exact determinant det(zI-D^-1 C)=z(z²-R0), hence R0<1 yields positive (I-Q)^-1 and a constant supersolution. Nonnegative fractional scalar kernels k_(nu,a) of mass 1/a and homogeneous Mittag-Leffler h_(nu,a)->0 imply the bounded majorant has limsup L<=D^-1 C L, forcing L=0 and all infected coordinates to zero for any real orders (0,1). Stable T,R,S resolvents prove global convergence, boundedness, and disease-free Lyapunov stability. Any nonzero infected-path seed contributes a positive multiple of nonintegrable h(t)~ t^-nu/(a Gamma(1-nu)); Tonelli transfer along E->I,A->g->E and I->T with kappa>0 forces all five ordinary-time integrals infinite even though coordinates vanish. With all orders 1, Hurwitz Metzler linear upper bound gives integrability. Exact independently checked symbolic characteristic polynomial and rational R0=1/24 example.

value.rationale: The same six-compartment unequal-order fractional epidemic model has a natural gap between asymptotic eradication and cumulative lifetime burden, which standard reproduction-number stability does not quantify. Showing coexistence of global clearance with nonintegrable literal occupancy and treatment incidence across all five compartments for arbitrary incommensurate orders is a meaningful qualitative distinction important when interpreting idealized fractional memory models; no claim about physical count forecasts is made.
